name: V3LUM core DNS-over-HTTPS resolver chain
operator: V3LUM core (routes every query to one of the configured resolvers: internal DoH, Google Public DNS, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 or Quad9)
tier_rationale: Virtual provider: queries only reach resolvers registered as their own trusted providers (internal_doh, google_public_dns, cloudflare_dns, quad9). Default resolvers are limited to providers whose terms allow business use (P029 cond 6).

reliability.justification: Relays authoritative DNS answers; the AD flag is reported as 'validated by resolver', never as proof, and SERVFAIL/REFUSED/timeouts stay 'could not verify'.

resolvers.title: DNS answers through the core DoH resolver chain (DoH-only modules declare this source)

terms.quote: Default resolvers are limited to providers whose terms allow business use, recorded with evidence in the provider registry (Google Public DNS, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9; tier trusted).

resolvers.notes: Quote: binding council text (P029 cond 6). Not counted in max_requests or quotas; the resolver hosts that received a value are listed in the disclosure ledger (res.hosts).

notes: Owned by core (WP02). DoH-only modules declare provider='core_doh', sources=('core_doh.resolvers',), hosts=(), disclosure='third_party', terms='open'.
